SELECT chatroom_seq.currval FROM dual
mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, cm.CONTENT AS last_chat, cm.SENT_AT AS last_message_time FROM chatroom cr JOIN chatroom_participants crp ON cr.ID = crp.CHAT_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CHAT_ROOM_ID, CONTENT, SENT_AT FROM ( SELECT cm.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CHAT_ROOM_ID ORDER BY SENT_AT DESC) AS rn FROM chat_message cm ) WHERE rn = 1 ) cm ON cr.ID = cm.CHAT_ROOM_ID WHERE crp.USER_UID = #{userUid} ORDER BY cr.CREATED_AT DESC
